extracted.intended_audience: University of Toronto researchers, faculty, staff, and research administrators
extracted.subtask_description: Landing page describing the University of Toronto Division of the Vice‑President, Research & Innovation services, forms, and administrative resources that support research, ethics, commercialization, agreements, and reporting across the institution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Quality Control/Assurance and Research Checklist
rubrics_metrics.description: Quality Control/Assurance and Research Checklist (listed under Forms & Templates).

rubrics_metrics.name: Protocol submissions and amendments: My Research Human Protocols (MRHP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Protocol submissions and amendments for human research are handled via My Research Human Protocols (MRHP).

rubrics_metrics.name: MRHP Application worksheet
rubrics_metrics.description: MRHP Application worksheet – to assist researchers with developing protocols with collaborators prior to submission through MRHP.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Designed to help researchers prepare required material and coordinate with collaborators before formal MRHP submission.

rubrics_metrics.name: Protocol Submissions and Amendments: My Research Animal Protocols (MRAP)
rubrics_metrics.description: Protocol submissions and amendments for animal research are managed through My Research Animal Protocols (MRAP).

rubrics_metrics.name: U of T Peer Review for Scientific Merit Submission Form
rubrics_metrics.description: U of T Peer Review for Scientific Merit Submission Form (for institutional peer review of scientific merit).

rubrics_metrics.name: U of T Peer Review for Scientific Merit Exemption Form
rubrics_metrics.description: U of T Peer Review for Scientific Merit Exemption Form (process to claim exemption from institutional peer review for scientific merit where applicable).

rubrics_metrics.name: Invention Disclosure Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Invention Disclosure Form (part of Inventions, Commercialization & Entrepreneurship workflow).

rubrics_metrics.name: Copyright Disclosure Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Copyright Disclosure Form (related to intellectual property and commercialization reporting).

rubrics_metrics.name: Confidential Information & Intellectual Property (CIIP) Agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Confidential Information & Intellectual Property (CIIP) Agreement used to govern confidential information and IP considerations between parties.

rubrics_metrics.name: One Way Confidentiality Agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: One Way Confidentiality Agreement (unilateral NDA template for disclosure protection).

rubrics_metrics.name: Mutual Confidentiality Agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Mutual Confidentiality Agreement (bilateral NDA template for mutual disclosure protection).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biological Material Transfer Agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Biological Material Transfer Agreement (for transfer of biological materials between parties).

rubrics_metrics.name: Biological Material Transfer Agreement for Evaluation Purposes
rubrics_metrics.description: Biological Material Transfer Agreement for Evaluation Purposes (specialized MTA for evaluation-only transfers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Service Contracts & Agreements: Project Summary Questionnaire
rubrics_metrics.description: Service Contracts & Agreements: Project Summary Questionnaire used as part of contracting and service agreement intake.

rubrics_metrics.name: Sponsored Research and Collaboration Agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Sponsored Research and Collaboration Agreement template and process for sponsored projects and collaborations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Visiting Scientist Agreement
rubrics_metrics.description: Visiting Scientist Agreement (terms and administrative requirements for visiting researchers).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Award Advance Budget Request (Advanced Spending)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Award Advance Budget Request (Advanced Spending) form for requesting advance access to research award funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Partial Funding Release Request Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Partial Funding Release Request Form used to request partial release of research funds.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage Research Funds – Research & Innovation Agreements
rubrics_metrics.description: Forms and processes for managing research funds and agreements (centralized financial and agreement templates listed under Manage Research Funds).

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Data & Analytics – DQRSP Template Access Request Form
rubrics_metrics.description: DQRSP Template Access Request Form – for Strategic Research Officers in Central Divisional Offices to access data/analytics templates.

rubrics_metrics.name: VPRI Dashboards Access Request Form
rubrics_metrics.description: VPRI Dashboards Access Request Form to request access to institutional research dashboards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Graduate and Undergraduate Course Templates
rubrics_metrics.description: Graduate Course Template – for Course-based Graduate Research; Undergraduate Course Template (templates to document course-based research components).

rubrics_metrics.name: Undergraduate Ethics Review Protocol Form – Student-initiated Projects
rubrics_metrics.description: Undergraduate Ethics Review Protocol Form for student-initiated projects requiring ethics review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Training Request Form and Documentation of External Training Form
rubrics_metrics.description: Training Request Form and Documentation of External Training Form for tracking and requesting researcher training activities.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research performance and institutional metrics
rubrics_metrics.description: Institutional performance indicators listed on the page (e.g., '#1 in Canada in global ranking', '$1.54B in sponsored research funding', '165 international & major national research accolades in 2024', '330 Canada Research Chairs', counts of PIs supported, grants managed, startup teams supported, etc.).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: These are public-facing metrics used to communicate institutional research scale and impact; they can serve as high-level performance indicators but are not procedural criteria.

rubrics_metrics.name: Research Alerts (requires a valid UTORid)
rubrics_metrics.description: Research Alerts sign-up for e-mail notifications on preferred research topics; requires a valid UTORid.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Procedural requirement: users must authenticate with institutional credentials to receive alerts.

rubrics_metrics.name: Centre for Research & Innovation Support (CRIS) services
rubrics_metrics.description: Reference to CRIS as a hub for researcher-centered services including training opportunities, self-serve tools, resources, and meeting facilitation services.
